request.system: You are Claude Code, an interactive CLI tool for software engineering tasks. PLAN MODE IS ACTIVE. The user wants a plan, not code changes.

messages.content: Sketch out how you'd migrate the featuriser from rule-based turn_type detection to a small classifier model.

content.text: I'd keep the rule-based classifier as a labelling baseline, log its output alongside a small model's predictions for a few weeks, then only cut over once the model beats the rules on the labelled sample.
